verdict.rationale: Jan documents a local OpenAI-compatible server at localhost:1337 whose /v1/chat/completions supports streaming and tool calling. It also exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint for Anthropic SDK clients, and the docs explicitly say Jan connects with Claude Code and OpenClaw, so a coding agent can use it as a backend. Missing for 10: a detailed first-party setup guide for specific coding agents (the Claude Code integration is only a one-line mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration that coding agents work reliably against it.
